If you want to use Arc Names, start at Quick start and work down the Using Arc Names section — registering, renewals, records, the marketplace. No code required.

If you are integrating Arc Names, start at Resolving .arc for the on-chain lookup path, then Contract addresses and the API endpoints.

Either way, read Safety & cautions before you sign anything.

Testnet

Arc Names currently runs on Arc Testnet. Names registered here are for testing. They carry no promise of a mainnet name, and the deployment may be reset. See Safety.
